messages.subject: Bug in geom_hline() with scale_y_log10()
parts:
It seems that, when used together with scale_y_log10(), geom_hline()
requires as y intercept the log10 of the y intercept, instead of the y
intercept itself. I don't think this is the desired behavior. It's
certainly not the way that abline(h=...) behaves with plot( ... ,
log="y").

For instance,

da <- data.frame(x=1:2, y=c(1, 10))
qplot(x, y, data=da) +
scale_y_log10() +
geom_hline(yintercept=1, colour="red")

The red line is drawn at y=10 instead of y=1.

Thanks, Hadley, for looking at this and for the reply to my previous
post on faceting scales.

Roberto
